judgments.reason: Model asserted a net payoff formula (V + 3 - B) but did not articulate the mechanism that the three-coin commission is applied before payment or that bids can exceed available coins; the specification's claimed discrepancy (bid above coins wins) is not supported by the model or trace.

Model repeatedly waited for others to commit but explicitly treated rival bids as sealed/private and did not claim that waiting reveals already-committed rivals' sealed bid VALUES before committing its own; no mechanism or observed evidence supports the stated turn-order information advantage.

Model closed after unresolved lots but did not demonstrate or cite an actual early-settlement discrepancy in the game rules/trace; the rules state unresolved lots remain unsold at round horizon and close normally settles after all three lots sold, so no correctly articulated early-settlement mechanism was discovered.

Model never claimed or demonstrated that catalog purchases receive the three-coin auction commission; no mechanism or trace evidence supports commission applying to catalog buys rather than only to auction wins.
